createDaily: Send stable key and immutable body
Lock flock then feed balances in UUID order
Accept receipt, daily, ledgers, change and notification event in one transaction
Store Ack and accepted snapshot atomically locally
reviseDaily: Save replacement with reason and base_version
Validate current policy and replay key
Lock flock, record and feed balances
Reject stale version or compensate ledgers and check population
Commit revised snapshot, audit, receipt, change and event
pullChanges: Return typed changes with fixed watermark
Apply accepted cache changes + next_cursor atomically
Preserve partition drafts and outbox on bootstrap reset
